answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering network participation to locked capital rather than ephemeral identities. Like a steady comet tracing a calculated path, agents prove their legitimacy by pledging a cipher of cryptographic value. By partitioning the network into a grove of validator nodes, the protocol ensures that an attacker must acquire a majority of the total supply, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
